regime_context: The thematic landscape shows Memory, HBM & Storage as the leader but with fading momentum (r10 -0.13, breadth 0.0). Cybersecurity (rank 2) and Managed Care (rank 3) both exhibit strong trend, high durability, and full breadth but are crowded. The absolute-trend gate is validated for drawdown control, not returns. Rotation is broad (70% eligible) but not directional (one_narrative false).
emerging_watch: Watch Cybersecurity (challenger) for a confirmed handoff. If Memory's r10 stays negative and durability falls below 0.5 while Cybersecurity maintains durability >0.8 and breadth =1.0, a rotation into Cybersecurity may be underway. Kill-criterion: Cybersecurity durability drops below 0.7 or breadth contracts below 0.5.

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity shows strong trend (hurst=trend), high durability (0.9), full breadth (1.0), and passes the absolute-trend gate (eligible), which historically reduced drawdowns. Crowding (z=2.22) merits caution but does not warrant a fade.
theses.dissent: Crowded positioning often leads to sharp drawdowns when the trend breaks; the trade may be overloved and prone to mean reversion.

falsifier.text: Durability drops below 0.7 and/or breadth contracts below 0.5, signaling loss of trend cohesion.

theses.subject: Managed Care & Insurers
theses.thesis: Managed Care exhibits a durable trend (hurst=trend, durability 0.78) with good breadth (0.778) and eligibility. The absolute-trend gate provides drawdown risk control, making it a defensive overweight despite crowding (z=1.68).
theses.dissent: Crowding could cause rapid unwinding; the theme is not as broad as Cybersecurity and may falter on rotation out of healthcare.

falsifier.text: Breadth falls below 0.5 and durability drops below the 0.5 eligibility threshold.

theses.subject: Crypto & Digital Assets
theses.thesis: Crypto & Digital Assets is ineligible (durability_bar 0.22), has a mixed hurst, and historical absolute-trend gate failure implies higher drawdown risk. No directional edge but gate-based risk avoidance.
evidence: backtest_verdict: absolute_trend_gate validated for risk control
theses.dissent: Crypto can have reflexive rallies unanchored from trend metrics; the gate might miss upside in a speculative burst.

falsifier.text: Crypto becomes eligible (durability_bar > threshold) and hurst turns to trend, indicating reduced drawdown risk per the gate.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
